tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures favor the siphon-memory ODE, but the five endpoints do not reliably distinguish fast relaxation from coupling strength. The trajectory batch is the only offered probe that directly addresses this ambiguity before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations leave no residual degrees of freedom, and the narrow horizon range makes the fast memory timescale hard to separate from coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane or Cobb–Douglas law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither static law represents the observed coupled transient lag or dependence on the initial state and memory.
The auxiliary measurement does not constrain the coupled dynamics.
